verdict.rationale: The Agents SDK is code-first: agents, tools, handoffs, guardrails, sessions, streaming, human-in-the-loop approvals, sandbox and voice agents, MCP, and tracing configuration are all defined and run programmatically through the Runner and SDK primitives. The only UI surface in evidence is the Traces dashboard, which visualizes data the SDK collects and controls in code (e.g. disabling tracing via env var). Missing for 10: evidence that dashboard trace data can be queried or exported via API, an explicit statement or independent confirmation of API/UI parity, and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found none).
